title: Temperature Conversion
text: Convert from temperature units to desired temperature units, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial unit} sets Input units; {Final unit} sets the output units. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial unit
params.values: Input units R (default) | F | C | K

params.name: Final unit
params.values: Output units K (default) | F | C | R
